lp.title: A 5-stage workflow
lp.desc: Scheme of Work → Lesson Plan → Enactment → Assessment → Reflect.

lp.title: Start from a card — or type
lp.desc: Tap a starter to load an editable prompt, or just describe your lesson.

lp.title: Everything to brief Co-Cher
lp.desc: Attach · add a file · dictate · optional lens · your school’s frameworks · Send.

lp.title: The Lesson Canvas
lp.desc: Your plan as a living document — and it autosaves as you go.

lp.title: Plan → … → Present
lp.desc: Five stages, from a written plan to teaching from it.

lp.title: The AI Tools — the heart of it
lp.desc: One-tap makers turn your plan into real classroom materials.

lp.title: Send it — a full plan appears
lp.desc: Objectives, staged activities, an E21CC focus, and an estimated time.

lp.title: It suggests the next move
lp.desc: Generate LI & SC · how to group · differentiation — one tap each.

lp.title: The Canvas fills in
lp.desc: Plan and Components done (green ticks); Stage is next.

lp.title: Tap a tool — say, YouTube
lp.desc: Every tool builds from the plan you just made. Give one a tap.

lp.desc: Real videos with search links — grouped into Show in class · Flipped · Teacher prep.

lp.title: Now the Slide generator
lp.desc: Same plan, one tap — Co-Cher writes a full, presentable deck.

lp.title: A full deck — from your plan
lp.desc: Titled, paced and ready to present in the browser, or print to PDF.

lp.title: It even builds the visuals
lp.desc: Charts, diagrams and comparisons — generated, not hunted for.

lp.title: Stage into timed segments
lp.desc: Turn the plan into a runnable, timed sequence — then Place and Present.

lp.title: Saved & reusable
lp.desc: Reopen, print, export to Word, or share — autosaved throughout.

admin.title: The whole admin side, one screen
admin.desc: Your school's forms, a free colleague, MOE circulars, and an event-drafting engine.

admin.title: Quick Tools — your school's own forms
admin.desc: AOR · Bus booking · Relief timetable · Org chart · Framework builder · and more.

admin.title: The real time-saver: New Event
admin.desc: One event usually means a stack of separate forms. Brief it once instead.

admin.title: Brief it once
admin.desc: Name it, date it, pick the type, and write a sentence or two on what's happening.

admin.title: Tick the documents you need
admin.desc: RAMS · Bus booking · Student list · Parent notification · AOR · and more.

admin.title: Co-Cher drafts them all
admin.desc: Every ticked document, written from your one brief — each with a status.

admin.title: A clear run of the event
admin.desc: Setup → RAMS → Bus → Students → Notify → AOR → Review.

admin.title: Track every document
admin.desc: Each carries its own status, so you and the office see what's cleared and what needs you.

admin.title: Open any — it's already written
admin.desc: Hazards, control measures, an emergency plan, a risk level — pre-filled from your brief.

admin.title: Find a Teacher — who's free right now
admin.desc: Pick a department, then a colleague. Availability is read live from the school timetable.

admin.title: A live, considerate answer
admin.desc: Free right now? Which periods are still open today? How heavy is their week?

admin.title: MOE Circulars & Directives
admin.desc: The latest circulars in one place — connect your school's portal to surface them.

admin.title: Every event, at a glance
admin.desc: Each event you run lives here with its progress — nothing slips through.

classes.title: All your classes, one place
classes.desc: Each class card shows the roster size and a glance at where they are.

classes.title: Start with Add Class
classes.desc: Give it a name, a level and a subject — that's the whole setup.

classes.title: Name · level · subject
classes.desc: Three fields and you're in. Everything else attaches to this class.

classes.title: Upload your students from a CSV
classes.desc: Drag & drop a CSV or Excel class list — a Name column is all that's required.

notes.text: A Name column is all you need

classes.title: A portrait of the whole class
classes.desc: Where the class sits across each competency — so every lesson starts from the learners.

notes.text: Who your class is, right now

classes.title: Not only E21CC
classes.desc: The tracking schema decides what you record against each student. Tap Change to switch it.

classes.title: Pick how this class is tracked
classes.desc: E21CC by default — or RAG, Mastery, Participation. Switching never deletes your data.

classes.title: Build a schema for anything
classes.desc: Name it, add your own fields and levels — perfect for group work, reading, or a project.

aol.title: Summative design, step by step
aol.desc: Setup → build the Table of Specifications → set demand → review & export.

notes.text: A Table of Specifications, done right

aol.title: Pick your taxonomy
aol.desc: Original 1D Bloom (topics × levels), or the revised 2D (knowledge × process).

aol.title: Your objectives + total marks
aol.desc: List one objective per line, and set the paper's total marks. That's the whole setup.

aol.title: Build the grid
aol.desc: One tap turns your objectives into a Table of Specifications you can fill.

aol.title: Objectives × Bloom's levels
aol.desc: Allocate marks in each cell — Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyse, Evaluate, Create.

aol.title: Balanced — and checked
aol.desc: Co-Cher totals the marks and flags when the paper matches your target.

aol.title: Set the cognitive demand
aol.desc: Lower-order, balanced, or higher-order — the mix maps straight to Bloom's levels.

aol.title: You review, then export
aol.desc: Confirm every question is sound, then print a student copy and a teacher copy with answers.

aol.title: Bloom's verbs, on hand
aol.desc: A quick reference for every level — so objectives and questions use the right verbs.
